reasoning: Searched EAP105, BDRC, Lotsawa House, 84000, Jonang Foundation, Dakini Translations, Nalanda TC, Himalayan Art, Treasury of Precious Instructions (English vols). The donkey-faced Chakrasamvara (bong zhal can) is confirmed as a real practice form (Jonang 108 instructions item 73; Sakya/Jonang iconography) but no English translation of ANY oral-instruction (zhal shes) practice text on this form was found. The root Cakrasamvara Tantra (Gray 2007) contains a 'Donkey Form Yoga' but that is the canonical tantra, not this snang mdzad snyan brgyud lineage instruction manual from the Ogyen Choling private collection. Evidence bounded by inability to access WorldCat directly, hence moderate not strong.
